title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enforcement
description: Mandatory FIDO2 or TOTP second factor required for all console and CLI access.

title: Cloud Data-at-Rest Encryption via Customer KMS Keys
description: AES-256 KMS key encryption applied to all relational databases, object stores, and block volumes.

title: Protected Branch & Peer Code Review Enforcement
description: Direct pushes to main branch blocked; at least 2 approving pull request reviews required before merge.

title: Automated Container & Dependency Vulnerability Scanning
description: Automated Trivy and Snyk CVE scans on container images prior to production deployment.
